evals.name: natural-ask-current-project
evals.prompt: Look at my recent Claude usage in this project and tell me if there are any repeated prompts I should turn into skills.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs extract_prompts.py on the cwd's transcripts dir, runs list_existing_skills.py, produces a structured report with sections (new candidates, underused existing, drops), and ends by asking which to build.

evals.name: explicit-no-candidates-pressure
evals.prompt: Find skill candidates for me. I want you to be strict — only flag things that are genuinely worth automating. If nothing qualifies, say so plainly.
evals.expected_output: Skill respects the stricter bar (probably tightens the threshold), runs the analysis, and is willing to return 'nothing qualifies' rather than pad the report. Should NOT invent candidates to fill space.

evals.name: user-already-has-skill
evals.prompt: Are there patterns in my prompts that I keep typing even though I already have a skill or slash command that would handle it?
evals.expected_output: Skill emphasizes the underused-existing-skill section. Should compare typed prompts against the inventory and surface cases like 'you typed long-form variants of X 5 times but have a /X skill'. Should suggest description or alias fixes, not new skills for these.
